ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, primarily in the central regions, surrounded by a low-intensity (black) border mapping covering 25-30% of the peripheral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous white pigmentation. Dense black pigmentation is mapped to the leading edge (lower boundary in current orientation) and lateral margins. Distinct black mottling and spot clusters are scattered across the white interior, with concentrated black pixel regions at the fluke-to-peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees; the notch depth creates a significant vertical depression between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete jagged peaks are mapped to the outer third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave geometric curve sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Roughly circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters and texture anomalies are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel black linear marks (rake marks) are mapped on the right lobe surface; a series of diagonal linear disruptions is visible on the inner-upper quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized yellowish-brown chromatic anomaly is visible on the lower-medial section of the right lobe, contrasting with the standard black/white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The pigmentation transition along the leading edge is characterized by heavy speckling and micro-mottling rather than a clean linear boundary.
